name: Insatsuya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood print shop: a business-card printing service announcement, a first day helping print flyers, a menu and price list with a point-card bonus, a large-poster printing service notice, a bookbinding-service comparison, a column on learning to ask customers about paper types, a part-timer lesson on basic printer operation, an explainer on why a photo-print corner started, a graduation-album printing application guide, a column on how more online orders changed the shop's day, a busy-season reception rule, a column on the meaning of a print shop's craft, and a one-year cooperation report with a nearby paper manufacturer.
